各具特色的女仆战斗？天使与恶魔的交锋？来看一看新作女仆肉鸽游戏 最近玩了《天使街区：女仆大冒险》这款游戏，这款游戏在steam上是有轻度Rougue标签，同时是提示有涩涩的内容，锁国区的，那么让我们深入了解一下这款游戏。 游戏体验： 这款游戏是肉鸽弹幕射击类型，游戏的玩法大家也比较常见了，当然我们看游戏名字能看出游戏涉及到天使和女仆，游戏的画面与场景立绘都比较精致，没有粗制滥造的感觉。游戏玩法是开局会给一个女仆进行操作与战斗，女仆的立绘也比较精致，战斗开始会有初始武器，有武器槽和道具槽，武器槽一共有六个，就是最多可携带六把武器，道具槽是无限制的。 一关是有好几轮敌人，每轮结束后都会给几个随机的提升女仆属性的效果进行选择（只在这一关有效），同时会进入商店可以购买武器和道具（购买武器和道具的代币是击杀敌人后掉落的水晶），有比较丰富的道具类型，比较有意思的是相同品质相同武器可以合成更高品质的武器，提升武器的上限。同时每个女仆都有专属的闪避技能和绝招，绝招可以快速消灭大量敌人造成大量伤害，技能动画也不错，在关卡结束后休息区可以用从关卡获得的道具强化女仆的基础属性与技能。 在关卡结束后会解锁新的女仆，每个女仆都有鲜明的立绘与性格风格，各有千秋，女仆还是很不错的，总有符合自己xp的女仆。这款游戏虽然显示有涩涩，但其实是在血量较低时会触发衣服破损的情况，这方面确实让人失望了，并不会露出什么关键地方。 游戏也有剧情背景，背景也比较经典，背景是王国遭到恶魔入侵，女仆酒吧“小小天使”的女仆长一直致力于对抗恶魔军团，建立了由各地的战斗女仆组成的世界防卫组织“蹭蹭女仆团”，由各种战斗女仆与恶魔对抗。剧情中也逐渐完善背景，从女仆长得知天使与恶魔曾经签订和平条约，但恶魔还是入侵了，并且要夺取天使“正义”的水晶，后面剧情发展就需要自己购买体验一番了。 总结： 游戏里面的剧情也有轻微的百合向，喜欢肉鸽弹幕射击的玩家可以考虑尝试一下，如果既喜欢肉鸽和女仆的玩家可以入手，平时可以当作休闲游玩一番，当然对于大家想看的内容这方面确实有写不足。总之，总体来看游戏质量还是不错的，游戏美术和音乐不错，有兴趣的小伙伴可以入手。 [quote]关注鉴赏组：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45134494]浮生评测[/url] ←"浮生若梦，一鉴倾心，邀您共赏人间烟火" 加入Steam组：[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/LLFLLFF]浮生评测[/url]←“一起追寻'浮生若梦'般的游戏体验” 开始“浮生若梦”鉴赏组的奇幻之旅！[/quote]

[h1] 「♥天使街区：女仆大冒险-天使女仆大战瑟琴魅魔♥」 [/h1] [h2] 「♥游戏介绍♥」 [/h2] 天使街区：女仆大冒险是MilkEmpire制作的一款类吸血鬼幸存者（土豆兄弟版）的肉鸽游戏，玩家需要操控好几个可爱的女仆战士，每个角色都有独特的技能和属性，根据不同的技能属性选择不同的装备流派，抵御一波又一波的敌人然后打败每关最后的魅魔BOSS。 游戏虽然锁国区，但是实际上并没有正经的R18内容，唯一比较瑟琴的就是战斗中低血量时有轻微爆衣立绘，还有打败魅魔boss后魅魔会被女仆长抓走做涩涩的事情，但是也没有过多的表现。序章还有全韩语配音（不过只有序章有，后面可能还没做呢。）不知道以后制作组会不会更新神秘内容，至少目前还没有。 [h2] 「♥游戏内容♥」 [/h2] 恶魔军团撕裂天幕，人类最后的据点只剩下 “小小天使” 酒吧。女仆长莫莉卡把性格各异的女仆们编成战斗小队，用爱与火力守护地球最后的净土。 游戏主要内容就是类似土豆兄弟的战斗方式，玩家只需要移动躲避敌人的子弹，武器会自动攻击敌人，打倒敌人捡钱，然后用钱升级装备购买道具，唯一不同的是本作中的角色还拥有闪避技能和特殊服务两种特殊技能。这两种技能根据使用的角色不同会有不同的效果，可以理解成人物的特殊机制。 游戏目前设置了两种模式，一种是常规的无尽模式，玩家可以在无尽的波次中拿到自己最强的配装，看看自己能撑到第几波，第二种则是剧情模式，玩家打10波，最后一波打败魅魔boss即可通关，然后就能看到魅魔被拉走涩涩的环节。打败后还能解锁困难难度，从10波变成15波。游戏中还有很多致敬其他游戏的彩蛋，比如土豆兄弟的土豆人雕像。 玩家通过游戏结束后结算可以拿到艾尔币，可以使用这些特殊货币来进行局外养成的解锁，游戏还在更新中，目前局外成长的种类还不够丰富，人物还有好多技能没有解锁。 [h2] 「♥总结♥」 [/h2] 天使街区：女仆大冒险是一款优秀的类幸存者游戏，虽然目前游戏内容还不多，但是游戏承诺未来会更新更多的新角色，现在入手还是可以期待一下的。适合喜欢幸存者游戏的玩家入手来体验一下，每位角色还有live2d的动态立绘，不同的角色剧情也不一样，绝对值得一玩。 [table][td]欢迎关注鉴赏家[url= https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45519015/]“无趣评测”[/url][/td][/table]

[後半に日本語レビューあり] [h1] A maid-themed roguelite/VS-style shooter that aims to snowball through synergies and flips the tide with “SS” [/h1] A survivors-style action game starring cute, anime-style “maid warriors.” By selecting from a large pool of weapons/items and stacking smart combinations, synergies make attack performance pop in a pleasing way. Each run is on the short side, and the snappy feedback plus the steady sense of unlocks make repeated play hard to tire of. Progress repeats “wave → pick → miniboss/boss.” Choices from gacha acquisition/purchase are plentiful, but many items come with clear drawbacks. Range extends but movement slows, firepower goes up but crit dies—how you square these trade-offs is both the appeal and the key point. If you ignore the negatives and force synergies, you tend to stall out from midgame on; conversely, if you build with each maid warrior’s traits and the future in mind, it tends to blossom all at once in the late game. Each maid warrior has unique abilities, and each also carries a trump card called “SS (Special Service).” In the instant of activation it can clean the screen, stop elites, or explode durability/damage for a short time, giving strong accents on both offense and defense. Once you learn the right moments to use SS, you’ll be able to push back the climactic density spikes of mid–late game. Consider the cooldown time and think about your usage timing. The visuals overflow with very cute and lewd maids/enemies and are highly likable. Even on the survivors side, amid the lively mix of cute maids vs large hordes, bullet and hit visibility is preserved, and the presentation during SS is exhilarating. The stage is centered on Akihabara-like streets and a hub maid bar, with light conversations and small gags that reinforce character. The story is kept modest so as not to harm the loop tempo. The first wall is getting used to the “line” of item interactions and penalty zones. Once you get the knack, the build grows interestingly with each gacha/level-up. It is made for people who like survivors/VS-style build construction × snowball and want to savor a more “manual cultivation” feel. The cute look hides a solid core; the more you play, the better it gets. It is currently in Early Access, and energetic updates are presented together with a roadmap. It can be said to be a work with very high expectations going forward. [h1] シナジーでスノーボールを狙い「SS」で戦況をひっくり返す、メイド系ローグライト・VS系シューター [/h1] 可愛いアニメ調の「メイド戦士」たちが舞台のサバイバー系アクション。大量の武器/アイテムから取捨選択し、賢い組み合わせでシナジーを積み上げていくと、攻撃性能が小気味よく跳ね上がる。1ランの時間も短めで、テンポの良いフィードバック、着実なアンロックの手応えで、周回しても飽きにくい。 進行は「ウェーブ→ピック→ミニボス/ボス」の繰り返し。ガチャ取得/購買の選択肢は潤沢だが、多くのアイテムには明確なデメリットが付く。射程は伸びるが移動が鈍る、火力は盛れるが会心が死ぬ──といったトレードオフをどう帳尻合わせするかが魅力かつ要点となる。マイナスを無視してシナジーを組むと中盤以降で失速し、逆に各メイド戦士の特性に応じた、将来を見据えたビルドを組むと終盤に一気に開花する傾向があった。 各メイド戦士には固有の能力があり、切り札となる「SS（スペシャルサービス）」も各自備えている。発動の一瞬で画面を掃除したり、エリートを止めたり、短時間だけ耐久/火力を爆発させたりと、攻守のアクセントが強い。ここぞのSSの使いどころを覚えると、密度が跳ね上がる中盤～終盤の山場も押し返せるようになる。クールダウン時間を考慮し、使用タイミングを考えよう。 ビジュアルは非常に可愛くえっちなメイドさん/敵さんたちで溢れていて好感度が非常に高い。サバイバー部においても、可愛いメイド×大群という賑やかさの中で弾やヒットの視認性が保たれており、SS時の演出も爽快感がある。舞台はアキハバラ風の街並みと、拠点のメイドバーを中心に、軽い会話や小ネタでキャラ性を補強。物語は控えめに、周回テンポを損なわない設計となっている。 アイテム相互作用やペナルティ域の「線引き」に慣れるまでが最初の壁。しかし一度コツを掴むと、ガチャ/レベルアップごとにビルドが面白く育っていく。サバイバー/VS系のビルド構築×スノーボールが好きで、より「マニュアル醸成感」を味わいたい人に刺さる作り。可愛い見た目に対して中身は骨太、遊ぶほど良さが増すタイプだ。 現在は早期アクセス状態となっており、精力的なアップデートがロードマップと共に提示されている。今後が非常に期待できる一作といえるだろう。 ※日本語版だけの不具合：現在、遠距離武器も近距離武器も、表記が「近距離」となっている。武器の属性アイコンの表記は正しいので、アイコンを見て判断しよう。 Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NGTUBAy8wg4 [quote][b]Check out our Steam curator ([url=store.steampowered.com/curator/36364102-Horny-Hentai-Festival/]link[/url]) , YouTube channel ([url=www.youtube.com/curatorhhf/]link[/url]), and X(Twitter) ([url=x.com/hhfcurator]link[/url])![/b][/quote]

Gameplay wise, it is like Brotato: You choose a stage, each one having a unique boss, and having a difficulty level that unlocks as you beat previous stage levels (beating a game in normal unlocks hard, et cetera). You choose a character, each with their own specialization and abilities, and you choose their starting weapon. You are put on a field, enemies come at you. You collect drops from enemies to use as currency and level up. Level up let's you increase one stat (speed, health regen, et cetera) of three randomly chosen stats once the level is over. The level is timed like Brotato, with currency being picked up after the timer is up. I don't think that the game has a bank mechanic like in Brotato. Once the level is over, you can buy weapons and items, and yes, like in Brotato, items synergize to give you an increase in effects. Unlike Brotato, there is a metacurrency that you can gain by working through levels, and you can use this currency to upgrade your maids (you characters, that is) in general, or give individual maids specific upgrades in their upgrade tree. Each maid's has upgrades that enhances their special ability, their dodge, or their class abilities, i.e., the maid who is the engineer gets upgrades that upgrade her engineering stat. Since the game is still in E.A., not all of the upgrades have been made yet. There is a story to the game, and the gist of it that Maids protect the world against demons. Go fight them, save the world. Each playable character has dialogue specific to them, and have their own unique reactions to the bosses of each stage, and the bosses have reactions to the maids. The main thing that sets this game apart from Brotato is the art style, the characters, and the story. If you don't like the anime-like art aesthetic and anime tropes, you probably won't like this game, unless you really want more Brotato and are willing to power through the art and tropes like a masochist. If you like anime and Brotato, you will probably like this game.

Surprisingly fun. There is already a pretty huge variety of upgrades available to direct your character's growth. Weapon variety is also solid. Maids have their own unique personalities, strengths and weaknesses, all of which work well together and serve to make them feel distinct. Each weapon is often part of at least one set, opening the door to multiple combinations that can augment your build (the sets themselves aren't crazy game-changers, but they can stack up nicely). The dev team has been great about posting what they're working on and putting out updates at a good pace. They've added maps + an endless mode, overhauled the maid lounge (where you handle meta-progression and so on), added more unlockable characters, and across multiple patches I haven't run into any bugs. The story is enjoyably ridiculous, and there's just the right amount of it to avoid killing your momentum (plus there's a skip button). The perspective is more zoomed-in than what we're used to with survivors-types, but the pacing, encounter spawns, and map layouts all make it work. Most of the in-game music slaps, though I'm hoping we get the option to select our combat track(s) at some point. The spicy content is pretty mild and restricted to cutscenes, but this absolutely works for the game. It isn't an H-game and doesn't need to be, but it isn't totally vanilla either. All-around great experience so far!

I've been attacking it on and off for the achievements. So far I do like it, though I'm greedy for more meta-progression and stuff in general as is usual for me. The gameplay is fairly standard for this genre, but that's not a bad thing, and the game runs well which is always good. Music's fairly catchy and the art style is pretty cute. Honestly, overall I'm pretty happy about the game in general, definitely gotten my money's worth so far. I like that each character has unique skills, though some are certainly far stronger than others. The weapons you can take all have scaling with stats too and some come with special bonuses too, so build variety is decent. I like that defensive builds are actually viable in this game; a lot of the ones in this genre harshly limit damage reduction and dodge, but this one doesn't. :3 Also FYI my favourite is playing as Genius, spamming turrets and watching everything die while I stack dodge/DR hehe. My only mild complaints are that it takes a while to get 10 wins for each character for the achievements, and that to me it feels like normal stages end right as you're getting your build going and endless mode ramps up too fast. Also [b]no playable Lillieth ; ;[/b] But nothing that'd stop me recommending it though. Will say I completely disagree with steam giving it an "adult only" rating; there's no nudity and barely any blood, though I suppose there is a mild dash of fanservice.
